 What time do polls open on Election Day in the Chicago area? What to know 
 Election Day is set for Nov. 3 
 By Izzy Stroobandt • 
 Published 1 hour ago • 
 Updated 59 minutes ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 You’re watching the NBC 5 Chicago News streaming channel, which plays local Chicago news 24 hours a day, seven days a week. You can find the “NBC 5 Chicago News” streaming channel on your phone or computer, and on Peacock, Samsung, Roku, Xumo or on our app, so you can watch our local news on your schedule.
 With just a few days left before Election Day for the 2026 Illinois general election , voters who have yet to cast their ballot may be wondering what time polling places will open their doors on the big day. 
 Though early voting has been open for weeks, many wait until Election Day itself, set for Tuesday, Nov. 3, to mark their support for their preferred candidates. 
 Stream NBC 5 for free, 24/7, wherever you are.
   WATCH HERE 
 Under Illinois state law, polls open at 6 a.m. on Election Day, and will remain open until 7 p.m.
 If you can't get to the polls until the later evening and you're stuck in line when the clock strikes 7 p.m., you'll still be able to vote. 
 Not sure where to go? 
 The Illinois State Board of Elections has a "polling place lookup" feature on its website.
 Put in your ZIP code and address and hit "submit" and the lookup tool will show you your polling place.

 Are you registered to vote? How Chicago area residents can check 
 Illinois Election 2026 
 Oct 27 
 NBC Chicago's Voter's Guide for the 2026 Illinois elections 
 Chicago residents can vote at their designated polling place or at one of the 51 early voting centers across the city that will remain open through Election Day .
 For those outside Chicago, a polling place search feature may be offered on your county clerk's website.
 Don't know if you're registered to vote?
 The Illinois State Board of Elections offers a registration lookup tool on their website. To look up if you're registered, you need to enter your first and last name, birthday and zip code.
 For Chicago residents, the city also offers its own voter registration search tool , that will also provide your precinct polling place or closest vote center.
